title: The batch poll loop holds its modes in control flow: a BatchWatch union with transition() could name them
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/upload-pipeline.ts processBatch: the while loop, realCompleted, the 10-min maxPollTime deadline and the abort signal carry processing, error, done, timed out and cancelled implicitly. Candidate shape (C18 design §6): BatchWatch = processing | error | done | timedOut | cancelled, events pollOk | pollFailed | deadline | cancel, with a table test. C18 (US-12 AC24) kept the minimal fix by owner ruling Q2. Done: processBatch holds one BatchWatch (watching | done | failed | timedOut | cancelled) changed only by the pure transition in widget-src/src/lib/batch-watch.ts, events polled | deadline | cancel, with a table test (owner D1 b, D2 b, D3 a, D5 b)
